$description: Copy for sign-in, invites, password reset, the People screen and Account. Theme-independent: these screens appear before a trip (and so a theme) exists, and account copy has to be plain first. Same {placeholder} rules as themes/*.json. See DESIGN_SPEC.md §6.13.
voice: Plain, warm, short. A light dry touch is fine; no theme vocabulary, no jokes in errors.

fields.name: Your name
fields.nameHint: This is what your friends see on the leaderboard.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.body: Sign in to get back to the trip.
signIn.inviteOnly: Drunkify is invite-only. Ask your admin for a link.
signIn.signedOutBanner: You’ve been signed out. Sign in again to carry on.

forgotSheet.title: Forgot your password?
forgotSheet.body: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link, if you have an account.
forgotSheet.sentBody: If that’s a Drunkify account, we’ve sent a link.
forgotSheet.sentBodyLogHint: No mail server configured — check the server log for the link.

setup.title: You’re the admin
setup.body: This account runs Drunkify. You invite people and can reset their passwords. Make it yours first.
setup.samePassword: Pick a password you haven’t used here before.

invite.title: {inviter} invited you to Drunkify
invite.body: Log drinks with the group on the trip, then watch it all come back in the Wrapped.
invite.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
invite.alreadyMember: This invite is for someone new, and you already have an account.
invite.createFooter: You’ll stay signed in on this phone.
invite.duplicateName: There’s already a {name} on this trip. Add an initial?
invite.emailTaken: There’s already an account with this email.

expired.title: This invite has expired
expired.body: Invites last 7 days. Ask {inviter} for a new one.

used.title: This invite has already been used
used.body: Each link works once. If it was you, sign in.

revoked.title: This invite was cancelled
revoked.body: Ask {inviter} if you should have a new one.

invalid.title: This link doesn’t work
invalid.body: It may have been cut off. Open it again from the message, or ask for a new one.

resetExpired.title: This reset link has expired
resetExpired.body: Reset links last 24 hours and work once. Ask your admin for a new one.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Password changed. You’re signed out everywhere else.

noTrip.title: You’re in
noTrip.body: You’re not on a trip yet. When someone adds you to one, it shows up here.
noTrip.adminBody: Invite your friends now; you can add them to a trip later.

errors.badEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.commonPassword: That one’s too easy to guess. Try something longer.
errors.badCredentials: That email and password don’t match.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Try again in {time}.
errors.offline: Can’t reach Drunkify. Check your connection and try again.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name}’s access?
removeConfirm.body: They’re signed out everywhere and can’t sign back in. Their drinks stay on the trip.

inviteSheet.title: Invite someone
inviteSheet.question: Who’s it for?
inviteSheet.footer: Works once, for one person. Expires {date}.
inviteSheet.shareMessage: {inviter} invited you to Drunkify. Tap to join: {url}
inviteSheet.shareMessageTrip: {inviter} invited you to {trip} on Drunkify. Tap to join: {url}
inviteSheet.resetFooter: Works once. Expires in 24 hours. Their old password stops working when they use it.
inviteSheet.resetShareMessage: Here’s your Drunkify password reset link: {url}

account.title: Account
account.emailNeedsPassword: Enter your current password to change your email.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out on this phone?
signOutConfirm.body: You’ll need your password to get back in.

forgotPassword.subject: Reset your Drunkify password
forgotPassword.body:
Hi,

Someone asked to reset the password for this Drunkify account. If that was you, set a new one here:

{link}

This link works once and lasts 24 hours. If it wasn’t you, ignore this email.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to Drunkify
invite.body:
Hi {name},

{inviter} invited you to Drunkify — join them on {trip}.

{link}

Works once. Expires {expires}.
